purpose: Fix actual component support and human dependencies, then perform bounded independent-input admission before any detection or paid model comparison.
scope: CPU preparation/provider-to-common-consumer evidence; one prospective issue and one normal reference at most
prior_screen_contact: All pool commits already contacted the historical short screening; this is not globally unseen material.
selection_kind: purposive metadata nomination and recorded contact review; not random or prevalence sampling
qualification: not previously used for method development or same repair family
identified provider and common consumer with comparable purpose/object/stage
historical interface or use requirement basis
normal reference has positive conditional guarantee, not merely no observed fault
initial_source_collection_limit: at most 8 complete parent files for the prospective issue and at most 8 for the normal reference, all paths named before collection; no recursive helper expansion
repair_policy: If qualification needs repair evidence, inspect separately after the parent packet is fixed. Do not read old refusal content or rephrase to recover it.
method_gate: N2.23 four-profile archive adapter is not eligible for unseen source detection. Core utilities need external premises; admission does not imply full N1/N2 readiness.
evaluation_if_admitted: Scope a same-material model/candidate-check comparison only after complete inputs and budget are registered; no claim of full detector accuracy.
stop: required tool input or reviewed premise absent
stop_action: Preserve disqualified/insufficient items and zero evaluated denominator; do not substitute repeatedly. Move to the already scheduled representation-interface admission after this bounded CPU gate.
closeout: Update the daily log and all three working notes; verify their Windows/WSL mirrors. No automatic Word edit or GitHub push.
